changes.title: Pirro Meets With Trump at the White House After He Said She ‘Choked’ in Reflecting Pool Case
changes.summary: President Trump said Jeanine Pirro, the U.S. attorney for Washington, D.C., “folded like an umbrella.” For now, her job appeared to be safe, according to two people familiar with the meeting.

changes.title: Trump cracks jokes at first White House Correspondents' Dinner
changes.summary: President Trump cracked jokes at the redo of the White House Correspondents' Dinner on Friday night, after an armed assailant upended April's dinner.

changes.title: 'The show must go on.' Trump makes jabs at rescheduled White House Correspondents' dinner
changes.summary: President Trump used his speech to attack his political opponents, members of the media and even members of his own cabinet. (Image credit: Rod Lamkey).

changes.title: White House Correspondents' Association scholarship recipients relive terrifying dinner
changes.summary: Kaitlin Bender-Thomas and Madison Maynard, two White House Correspondents' Association scholarship recipients, join "The Daily Report" to reflect on April's terrifying shooting ahead of the rescheduled dinner.

changes.title: Trump returns to correspondents' dinner 3 months after shooting
changes.summary: President Donald Trump returned to the rescheduled White House Correspondents' Association dinner Friday night, delivering a rambling, hour-long speech. (Image credit: Rod Lamkey).
